results.title: Preserve nonblocking callback acquisition when adapting locks
results.text:
Preserve nonblocking callback acquisition when adapting locks
A source callback may return immediately when spin_trylock fails; replacing it with blocking lock changes progress.
Check whether the source obligation requires immediate failure. Asterinas SpinLock::try_lock returns None on failed acquisition, whereas lock busy-waits. Keep the early return when required; mutex exclusion alone is insufficient.
A callback with an evidenced nonblocking failure path, using the cited Asterinas revision. Check guardian, interrupt, lifetime and caller conditions for each driver.
Source-backed interpretation only. No translated driver or runtime test is certified by this record. Other revisions require revalidation.
